glosses: Placer quelqu’un dans un hôpital afin d’y être soigné ou d’y recevoir un traitement médical.

examples.text: Alors qu’il purge une peine à perpétuité pour crimes de guerre, l’ancien chef militaire des Serbes de Bosnie, Ratko Mladic, a été hospitalisé « en mauvais état de santé », a déclaré son fils, Darko Mladic, dimanche.
Les Grecs émigrés de Turquie étaient à eux seuls un million cinq cent mille. Jamais le gouvernement hellénique n'eût pu les hospitaliser sans le secours de la S.D.N..
Depuis une huitaine les Babouin hospitalisent un de leurs amis, un ligueur de l´Agitation française, auquel ils ont cédé une des chambres de leur villa.

glosses: in ein Krankenhaus aufnehmen/einweisen (mit und ohne Einverständnis des Patienten)

examples.text: Er erlitt in jungen Jahren einen Nervenzusammenbruch und musste hospitalisiert werden.

glosses: von Hospitalismus (psychologische Reaktion auf Einsamkeit oder Infizierung mit Krankenhauskeimen) betroffen sein

examples.text: Das Hospitalisieren führte dazu, dass sich diese Kinder autistisch in ihre eigene Welt zurückgezogen.

glosses: To send to hospital; to admit (a person) to hospital.
To render (a building) unfit for habitation, by long continued use as a hospital.
To cause (a person) to require hospitalization.
Said of an injury or illness.

examples.text: Shortly after World War I started, a painful arthritis in his knees hospitalized him.

He fought on the ever-retreating front until July, 1943, without injury but then took a bullet in his helmet, his first wound, which hospitalized him for four weeks. […] ¶ […] ¶ […] Hospitalized again, he was later assigned to a supply unit until again hospitalized by a deep infection behind his knee.

My father had begun his long, slow decline long before that, but subsequently, on each of the anniversaries of her death, he had suffered increasingly debilitating crises that had hospitalized him and left him still more frail than before.

glosses: To cause (a person) to require hospitalization.
Said of an assailant or other person.

examples.text: For example, just this month in Los Angeles a Jewish school principal was beaten and hospitalized by angry Hispanics who were upset because the mostly-Latino school their kids went to didn't also have a Hispanic principal.
One teacher in a Rochester, NY, school was hospitalized by an angry parent who came to school and attacked the teacher.
My step-brother, on his mission, was hospitalized by an angry inactive mormon.

glosses: zo gewend zijn geraakt aan de verzorging in een ziekenhuis dat men zich daarbuiten nauwelijks kan handhaven

examples.text: Инсульт ― критическое состояние, поэтому больного необходимо госпитализировать в течение 3-6 часов.
Столичная альтернативная «скорая помощь», если терпит время, госпитализирует пациентов в московские клиники.
